title: Kagamine Rin — Dressing Up Is Hard〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, I think it's finished.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Cool! It looks way different from your original sketch!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, it feels a lot warmer now with these colors...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(This is really strange...
I can't seem to look away for some reason.)
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, Rin, there you are!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
The same old SEKAI as always. This place really is nice...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You won't believe how cold it's gotten recently. I feel a lot better now that I'm over here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Are you here to get warm...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Nope.
I was working and got stuck for ideas.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, Rin, I thought I'd come chat with you♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, why are you scooching away?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You just want to use me as a mannequin again, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? That's not what I'm here to do. Just who do you take me for?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, what's that you're hiding behind your back?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, these? They're a bunch of cute accessories and stuff I bought. I wanted you to see them, Rin♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I just want you to see how cute they are. So, come take a look.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I guess I don't mind just looking. It's not like I have anything else to do...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Awesome!
I found this great trinket shop the other day.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They had earrings with ribbons, hairpins that looked like flowers and a ton of other accessories.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is this a cat...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah.
The pendant is a cat's face...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And the clasp has little paw charms on it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If you put this on, Rin, it might even turn KAITO's frown upside down.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I doubt it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. I still think it's worth a try.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Anyway, I've still got lots more.
See anything you like?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Anything I like...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Are you interested in this brooch?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. This color feels really familiar for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think I know why.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Remember that drawing Ena made the other day?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Her drawing...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I figured you liked it since you kept staring.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I remember now...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She recolored it over and over again because she didn't feel happy with the result.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that one! I immediately thought of it when I saw this brooch in the store.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I thought it'd look great on you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, I'm giving it to you♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I didn't say anything about wanting it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I know.
But I want you to have it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It would make me happy to see you wear it every once in a while, though.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If I feel like it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, that's fine!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Anyway, I should get back to work.
I need to finish what I was doing before the others arrive.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Bye, Rin. See you later.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. You're welcome!
